title: Semantic artifacts for: Making geospatial data FAIR for digital health: a semantic interoperability framework
description: Semantic artifacts accompanying the manuscript Making geospatial data FAIR for digital health: a semantic interoperability framework. Contains per-source data-preprocessing scripts, Ontop OBDA mappings exposing a virtual RDF layer over PostgreSQL/PostGIS, ShEx schemas extracted with sheXer, function-by-function GeoSPARQL conformance tests across SPARQL endpoints, and SSSOM mapping sets aligning contextual-indicator and geographic-area fields to Wikidata identifiers. Source geospatial data are not redistributed; RDF is generated virtually and not stored.
notes: X.Y. was supported by the China Scholarship Council (CSC; File No. 202208140027).
